service_scope.value: Standing seam metal roofing for coastal conditions (salt air, hurricane winds, UV, humidity): concealed fasteners, wind-uplift resistance; page says 'We install Kynar 500 and Hylar 5000 coated standing seam panels in a range of profiles and colors', with colour submittals for HOA communities. Also repair and re-coating of older metal systems: panel re-coating, sealant replacement, panel replacement, with a repair-versus-replace comparison. Page says a properly installed metal roof with a marine-grade coating carries a 40-year manufacturer warranty. Page cost claims (standing seam 2.5x-3x shingles, about $22,000-$40,000 vs $9,000-$18,000) are unconfirmed.
service_scope.source: Live site https://apexroofingtlc.com/metal-roofing/ (read 2026-10-11) — not confirmed by the client or Paul

service_process.value: Process is only lightly described: free consultation first; colour submittals and ARB submissions for HOA communities; repair assessed against replacement for damaged metal. No step-by-step install method on the page.
